achievements.name: Orpheon Escape
achievements.detail: Escape the frigate Orpheon before its self-destruct countdown ends.

achievements.name: Varia Suit
achievements.detail: Recover the Varia Suit and cross rooms hot enough to drain the Power Suit.

achievements.name: Ice Beam
achievements.detail: Recover the Ice Beam and freeze enemies where they stand.

achievements.name: Wave Beam
achievements.detail: Recover the Wave Beam. Its electric bolts home in while you lock on, and it opens purple doors.

achievements.name: Boost Ball
achievements.detail: Find the Boost Ball and accelerate while rolled into Morph Ball form.

achievements.name: Space Jump
achievements.detail: Recover the Space Jump Boots and jump a second time in the air.

achievements.name: Spider Ball
achievements.detail: Obtain the Spider Ball and roll along magnetic rails.

achievements.name: Gravity Suit
achievements.detail: Recover the Gravity Suit and move at full speed underwater.

achievements.name: Flaahgra
achievements.detail: Defeat Flaahgra by aiming the Sunchamber's reflected sunlight at it.

achievements.name: Thardus
achievements.detail: Defeat Thardus, the rock beast in Phendrana Drifts.

achievements.name: Chozo Artifacts
achievements.detail: Collect all twelve Chozo Artifacts and break the seal on the Impact Crater.

achievements.name: Metroid Prime
achievements.detail: Defeat the Metroid Prime at the core of the Impact Crater.

achievements.name: Logbook Full
achievements.detail: Scan every entry until the Log Book has nothing left to record.

achievements.name: Every Upgrade
achievements.detail: Win the final fight after every expansion and upgrade on Tallon IV has been collected.
